title: New test duplicates the taken-over fixture verbatim from the test directly above it
evidence: New test: "let taken = reference_call.ReferenceCallDetail(..contact_row("rc-1", ContactInitiated), taken_over_at: Some("2026-08-03T08:00:00Z"), attempt_log: [reference_call.AttemptLogEntry(kind: "invitation_sent", at: "2026-08-01T10:04:00Z", channel: "email", outcome: "delivered", detail: ""), reference_call.AttemptLogEntry(kind: "taken_over", at: "2026-08-03T08:00:00Z", channel: "", outcome: "", detail: "")],)". Existing test at 1521-1543: identical construction (same taken_over_at, same two AttemptLogEntry values), differing only in a comment line.
detail: AGENTS.md mandates DRY for logic repeating 2+ places. The ~23-line ReferenceCallDetail fixture now exists verbatim in two adjacent tests (both extending contact_row with the same taken_over_at + attempt_log); the comment inside the older fixture has already started to drift.
recommended_fix: Extract a taken_over_contact_row() helper (mirroring contact_row at line 1283) returning the taken-over ContactInitiated detail with the two-entry attempt log, and use it in both tests.
